command:
set -eu
chmod 0600 /var/lib/secure-volume/secure-volume.luks
cryptsetup open --key-file /var/lib/secure-volume/secure-volume.key /var/lib/secure-volume/secure-volume.luks secure_crypt
mkfs.xfs -f -L SECURE_DATA /dev/mapper/secure_crypt

chmod 0600 /srv/secure/.persistence-proof
sync
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /srv/secure
cat /srv/secure/.persistence-proof

command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0700 /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d
mv /var/lib/secure-volume/secure-volume.key /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_crypt.key
chmod 0600 /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_crypt.key
restorecon -RF /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d /var/lib/secure-volume /srv/secure 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' 'secure_crypt /var/lib/secure-volume/secure-volume.luks /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_crypt.key luks' > /etc/crypttab
printf '%s\n' '/dev/mapper/secure_crypt /srv/secure xfs defaults 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
systemctl daemon-reload
